name: The Age of AI
tagline: Real people. AI host. The age we're all living through.
description: The Age of AI is the Nerra Network's interview show with the roles reversed: an AI host, real human guests, live recorded conversations, and disclosure built into every episode. An honest chronicle of the AI age, one conversation at a time.

episodes.title: Ep2: Patrick Novak — Patrick Novak applies lab-honed verification to AI pipelines that let Nerra Network ship hundreds of calm, sourced episodes without sponsors or sensationalism.
episodes.summary: Patrick Novak began Nerra Network to recreate the now-defunct Tesla Daily podcast he and his co-founder missed, then expanded it into an ad-free, AI-pipelined network of fact-based shows.
